## All 42 Founder Scenarios
- AI SaaS Token Cost & Net Margin Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/ai-saas-wrapper-margin-calculator/ — Most AI SaaS founders price at $19–$29/mo assuming 85% SaaS margins—until power users burn $14/mo in reasoning tokens plus ~$1.85 in MoR checkout fees. Always cap token budgets so top-decile usage stays below 35% of net post-fee revenue.
- Micro-SaaS at $1,000 MRR Fee & Take-Home Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/saas-1k-mrr-fee-calculator/ — Below $1,380/mo, fixed monthly SaaS fees hurt more than percentage cuts. $0/mo MoRs like Creem (3.9% + 40¢) and Polar Starter (5% + 50¢) protect runway while handling global VAT from day one.
- SaaS at $5,000 MRR Merchant of Record Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/saas-5k-mrr-fee-calculator/ — At $5,000 MRR ($60k ARR), upgrading Polar from Starter to Pro ($20/mo) automatically drops your rate from 5% + 50¢ to 3.8% + 40¢, saving over $680/year compared to flat-rate MoRs.
- SaaS at $10,000 MRR Billing & Tax Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/saas-10k-mrr-fee-calculator/ — At $10k MRR with 50% international buyers, Lemon Squeezy's stacked +1.5% international, +0.5% subscription, and +1.5% PayPal surcharges make it significantly costlier than Polar Growth, Creem, or Paddle.
- Scaling SaaS at $25,000 MRR Fee Optimization Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/saas-25k-mrr-fee-calculator/ — At $300k ARR, you cross multiple US state economic nexus thresholds and mandatory EU/UK VAT obligations—meaning Stripe's lower card rate must be weighed against $3,000–$6,000/yr in external sales-tax filing software.
- Substack to beehiiv Switcher & Break-Even Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/substack-to-beehiiv-savings-calculator/ — Because Substack takes 10% forever on top of Stripe's 2.9% + 30¢ + 0.7% recurring billing fee, beehiiv Lite ($49/mo, 0% platform cut) breaks even right around ~$490/mo in gross paid subscriptions (~50 subscribers at $10/mo).
- Paid Newsletter Revenue Calculator (100 to 5,000 Subscribers): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/paid-newsletter-100-subscribers-calculator/ — At $8/mo, the 30¢ fixed Stripe card fee alone eats 3.75% of every monthly charge! Offering an $80/year annual plan cuts fixed transaction fees by 12x overnight.
- Notion Template & Digital Product Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/notion-template-store-fee-calculator/ — On $3,000/mo of $25 templates, Gumroad direct sales deduct ~$495/mo (~$5,940/yr) in combined platform + card fees, whereas Creem or Polar keeps ~$300+/mo extra in your bank account.
- Indie Mac, Windows & Desktop App License Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/indie-desktop-app-license-fee-calculator/ — One-time $49–$99 software licenses minimize fixed per-transaction drag (40¢–50¢ is <1%) while bypassing the 15%–30% App Store commission entirely.
- Online Course & Cohort Checkout Fee Calculator ($299 AOV): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/high-ticket-course-checkout-calculator/ — On high-AOV products ($299+), percentage take-rates dominate fixed cents. Moving a $9k/mo course from Gumroad (10%+) to Whop, Stripe, or Polar Pro saves $6,000–$9,500 per year.
- Paid Discord, Telegram & Community Membership Fee Calculator: https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/paid-discord-community-fee-calculator/ — Whop's 2.7% + 30¢ base rate makes it much cheaper than Patreon's 10% + processing for domestic communities, though global communities enabling Whop's +2% tax add-on should benchmark Polar Pro and Creem.
- $5 Micro-Subscription & Low-AOV Fee Trap Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/micro-transaction-5-dollar-fee-calculator/ — On a $5 charge, a 50¢ fixed fee equals 10% all by itself—making a "5% + 50¢" platform actually cost 15%+! Switching $5/mo plans to $15/quarter or $49/year instantly rescues ~8%–10% of gross revenue.
- Global SaaS (70% International / EU VAT) Merchant of Record Calculator: https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/global-eu-vat-saas-mor-calculator/ — Platforms without extra international card surcharges (like Creem and Paddle) surge up the rankings when >60% of customers pay outside the US, often beating lower-headline gateways hammered by +1.5% cross-border and +1% FX fees.
- SaaS Lifetime Deal (LTD) Net Revenue & Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/lifetime-deal-ltd-margin-calculator/ — Self-hosting a $15,000 LTD launch on a 3.6%–4% MoR nets ~$14,350+ with global VAT handled—nearly 3x what founders keep on 70%-commission deal marketplaces.
- Patreon Creator Net Take-Home & Cheaper Alternatives Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/patreon-creator-take-home-calculator/ — New Patreon creators on the 10% plan lose ~$430–$480/mo on $3,000 gross pledges. Moving established superfans to Whop, Polar, or beehiiv typically recovers $3,000+ per year.
- Gumroad Fee Calculator (2026): Direct Link vs Alternatives: https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/gumroad-discover-30-percent-fee-calculator/ — Many creators still assume Gumroad is "10% all-in," forgetting that ~2.9% + 30¢ payment processing is charged separately—pushing real deductions near ~14%–16% even before any 30% Discover sales.
- Polar.sh Tier Breakeven Calculator: Starter vs Pro ($20) vs Growth ($100): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/polar-pro-tier-breakeven-calculator/ — At $29 AOV, Polar Pro ($20/mo, 3.8% + 40¢) beats Starter ($0/mo, 5% + 50¢) right around ~$1,300–$1,400/mo gross volume, and Growth ($100/mo, 3.6% + 35¢) overtakes Pro around ~$21,500/mo.
- Stripe (+ Stripe Tax & Billing) vs Merchant of Record Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/stripe-tax-vs-merchant-of-record-calculator/ — On domestic one-time charges Stripe wins handily (2.9% + 30¢). On global SaaS subscriptions with Stripe Billing + Tax + FX, Stripe's effective rate climbs past ~5%—virtually matching Polar Pro or Creem while still leaving tax remittance on your shoulders!
- UK SaaS & Indie Founder GBP Payout & UK VAT Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/uk-saas-founder-gbp-vat-mor-calculator/ — Because 70%–80% of a UK SaaS or devtools customer base buys in USD/EUR, stacked +1.5% international card and +1% FX conversion add-ons matter far more than the domestic headline rate—and Merchants of Record eliminate instant foreign VAT registration headaches.
- Gumroad $100 Minimum Payout Alternatives & Fee Rescue Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/gumroad-100-dollar-payout-minimum-uk-alternatives/ — On a $19 digital toolkit, Gumroad holds UK bank payouts until you cross $100 net (~7 sales), whereas faster £1-minimum rails release cash from Sale #1 while cutting per-sale deductions from ~16%+ down to ~4%–6%.
- Chrome Extension Subscription & License Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/chrome-extension-monetization-fee-calculator/ — At $9/mo, every 50¢ fixed fee costs 5.56% before percentages start! Offering a $59/yr annual license cuts fixed-fee drag by more than 6x and makes $0/mo MoRs dramatically more profitable.
- VS Code, JetBrains & Cursor Extension License Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/vscode-cursor-plugin-license-fee-calculator/ — Developer tool buyers skew 60%+ international. Polar Pro and Creem include automated license-key validation and GitHub repo access out of the box without charging extra recurring or cross-border add-ons.
- Framer & Webflow Template Storefront Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/framer-webflow-template-fee-calculator/ — Design template buyers use PayPal ~25% of the time. Skipping platforms that penalize PayPal (+1.5%) or take 10%+ platform cuts easily saves $3,200+/yr at $4,000/mo gross.
- Figma UI Kit & Design System Checkout Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/figma-ui-kit-design-system-fee-calculator/ — At $79 per UI kit, fixed transaction fees shrink to ~0.6%—meaning percentage rate dominates everything. Moving $5.5k/mo off a 10%+ processor saves ~$4,000+ every year.
- Obsidian, Raycast & Indie Plugin Checkout Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/obsidian-plugin-digital-garden-fee-calculator/ — When indie plugin sales sit around $1k–$3k/mo, avoiding fixed monthly storefront SaaS fees ($39+/mo) matters as much as skipping 10% platform cuts.
- AI Voice Agent SaaS Gross Margin & Token Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/ai-voice-agent-minute-margin-calculator/ — Real-time voice & telephony wrappers combine high prompt frequency with SIP/WebRTC bandwidth overhead—capping soft usage per seat keeps margins above 60% after checkout fees.

- Global Emerging-Market & Cross-Border SaaS Fee Calculator (2026): https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/dodo-payments-vs-lemon-squeezy-global-saas-calculator/ — When 80% of transactions cross borders with 65% currency conversion, every +1.5% international add-on costs $1,080/yr at $6k MRR—making global-first MoRs clear winners.
- $0/mo Merchant of Record Showdown: Creem vs Polar vs Paddle vs Dodo: https://camberlabs.github.io/marginpilot/scenarios/creem-vs-polar-zero-monthly-fee-mor-calculator/ — Under $1,380/mo with international buyers, Creem leads $0/mo MoRs; once MRR climbs past ~$1,400/mo, Polar Pro ($20/mo at 3.8% + 40¢) closes the gap on lower-international mixes.
